title: CONUS Hail Catastrophe Model
description: A radar-based probabilistic hail hazard model for the Continental United States. Ingests NOAA MYRORSS, NCAR GridRad, and NOAA MRMS radar-derived MESH over a 28-year convective-day record (1998–present), applies bias correction and environmental filtering, fits regional Generalised Pareto Distribution tails, and generates analytical and 50,000-year stochastic return-period hazard maps on a 0.05° CONUS grid.
